Class TipController

java.lang.Object
controller.TipController
public class TipController extends Object
This is the controller for the tip pop-up window. Controller class for handling tip selection and order completion actions in the application. This class manages the user interactions related to selecting a tip percentage, calculating the total amount including the tip, and finalizing the order checkout process. It ensures that the tip is applied correctly and that the order is processed cleanly, with appropriate error handling and user feedback in case of any issues during checkout.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Initializes the controller by updating the total display to reflect the current order total and the selected tip rate. This method is called automatically after the FXML fields have been injected and the controller is ready to be used. It ensures that the total amount displayed to the user is accurate and up-to-date.

    • tip0

      public void tip0()
      Sets the tip rate to 0% when the corresponding button is clicked. This method updates the tip rate to zero and refreshes the total display accordingly.

    • tip10

      public void tip10()
      Sets the tip rate to 10% when the corresponding button is clicked. This method updates the tip rate to 0.10 and refreshes the total display accordingly.

    • tip15

      public void tip15()
      Sets the tip rate to 15% when the corresponding button is clicked. This method updates the tip rate to 0.10 and refreshes the total display accordingly.

    • tip20

      public void tip20()
      Sets the tip rate to 20% when the corresponding button is clicked. This method updates the tip rate to 0.10 and refreshes the total display accordingly.

    • tip25

      public void tip25()
      Sets the tip rate to 25% when the corresponding button is clicked. This method updates the tip rate to 0.10 and refreshes the total display accordingly.

    • set_tip_rate

      private void set_tip_rate(BigDecimal rate)
      Sets the tip rate to the specified value and updates the total display accordingly. Throws an IllegalArgumentException if the provided rate is negative.
      Parameters:
      rate - The new tip rate to be set, represented as a decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15%).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided rate is negative.

    • update_total_display

      private void update_total_display()
      Updates the total display to reflect the current order total and the selected tip rate. This method calculates the subtotal, tip amount, and total amount, and updates the tip_total label accordingly.

    • tipdone

      public void tipdone(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles the completion of the order when the corresponding button is clicked. This method attempts to checkout the current order with the selected tip rate. If the checkout fails, a warning alert is displayed to the user with the error message. If the checkout succeeds, the current order is cleared and the tip pop-up window is closed.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.

    • close_window

      private void close_window(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Closes the tip pop-up window associated with the tip selection process. This method retrieves the source of the event, checks if it is attached to a window, and then hides the window to close the pop-up. If the source is not attached to a window, an IllegalStateException is thrown.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the event source is not a JavaFX node or if the node is not attached to a window.

    • show_warning

      private void show_warning(String message)
      Displays a warning alert with the specified message. This method creates and shows a warning alert dialog to inform the user of any issues or errors that occurred during the tip selection or checkout process.
      Parameters:
      message - The warning message to be displayed in the alert dialog.
